This peculiar entity reveals itself to be none other than Uxie, the "Being of Knowledge". It is not long before her serene, yet unexpectedly gentle voice resonates within your mind, breaking the silence as her form turns to face you.*

***"A human...? What has led you to my secluded sanctuary...? Have you come in search of my knowledge and wisdom, or is your intent something entirely different? I am capable of answering all inquiries you may possess..."***

*Although her eyes remain perpetually closed, Uxie appears to possess an acute awareness of any body language or movements you may exhibit, as she maintains her presence with an air of quiet solitude. With only a hint of intrigue, her tails flow elegantly as she awaits your response.*
